evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Story provides the creation capability for games, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Story enables inviting estimators, which is a necessary step for game participation; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Story enables starting a round with an item, and item creation is covered by PP-006.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Story reads items, and item creation (PP-006), update (PP-007), and delete (PP-008) are present.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items presupposes their existence, which is covered by item creation (PP-006).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation capability for items, complementing read (PP-004), update (PP-007), and delete (PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Update capability for items is present, and creation (PP-006) and delete (PP-008) are also present.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete capability for items is present, and creation (PP-006) and update (PP-007) are also present.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Story enables showing estimates; estimate creation and management are covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Story enables accepting an estimate, and estimate creation is covered by estimation stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Story automates estimate entry; manual entry is covered by PP-012.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of estimates is present; automatic entry is covered by PP-011.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported; initial estimation is covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Provides an alternative way to create items; complements manual creation (PP-006).

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Alternative item creation method; complements other item creation stories.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Read capability for games; creation (PP-001) and delete (PP-020) are present.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Read capability for game transcripts; creation is implied by game play and estimation stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is a complementary capability to viewing (PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Alternative export format; complements transcript viewing and exporting.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete capability for games; creation (PP-001) and read (PP-016) are present.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present; update (PP-023) and delete (PP-024) are also present.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is a necessary capability; account creation (PP-021) is present.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Update capability for accounts; creation (PP-021) and delete (PP-024) are present.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Delete capability for accounts; creation (PP-021) and update (PP-023) are present.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a display feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a necessary account recovery feature; complements account management.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Story provides configuration for estimation; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Story limits the number of estimators; complements invitation (PP-002).

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Story enables estimators to join games; invitation (PP-002) is present.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Story provides read access to the current item; item creation (PP-006) is present.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Story provides read access to all items; item creation (PP-006) is present.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Story provides feedback on estimation progress; estimate creation is covered by estimation stories.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a reveal mechanism for estimates; estimate creation is covered.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Story allows updating an estimate before finalization; estimate creation is covered.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Story provides read access to historical estimates; estimate creation is covered.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Story provides read access to current round estimates; estimate creation is covered.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a timer feature; reset capability is covered by PP-038.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Story provides automatic reset for the timer; starting the timer is covered by PP-037.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Story provides read access to historical data; creation is covered by estimation stories.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a display consistency feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Story allows updating an estimate before finalization; estimate creation is covered.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a display feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Story provides documentation; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a performance optimization; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a compatibility requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Story provides an accessibility requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a performance requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Story provides an internationalization requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a usability requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Story provides an error handling requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a privacy requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Story provides a reporting feature; no missing complementary capability.
